report.headline: The logging fix is confirmed and nothing it touched broke; the round remains usable with the same two gaps as before: a generic bad-model message and an incomplete live grading record.
works: All 60 server tests pass, including the Reviser's new regression test for unexpected-error logging.
Hand reproduction against a loopback server: a plain Error now logs its message with the request id, while the browser still gets only the generic message.
Provider errors still log only safe fields (provider, category, exit code); raw CLI stderr does not reach the log.
Known AppError messages are unchanged in logs and responses.
Whitespace check on the diff is clean; the change touched only the error handler and one test file.
broken: An unavailable model name still produces the generic 'temporarily unavailable, retry' message for both CLIs instead of a model-unavailable message (unchanged from audit 1).
Codex's nine live grading cases ran before the narration schema fix, so the full per-case record is still incomplete (unchanged from audit 1).
not_checked: Claude's nine live grading cases still rest on the Performer's report; the live call budget was exhausted in audit 1.
Browser playthroughs were not repeated; the correction did not touch client or provider code.
If a route ever throws a non-Error value, the log line ends in 'undefined'. Cosmetic; not exercised by real code paths.
needs_you: Decide whether to allow two extra live calls so the bad-model error can be mapped properly. I recommend allowing it; otherwise accept the generic message.
Optionally run npm run verify:cli for each provider yourself (14 calls each) for the full nine-case live record.

fixes.what: Unexpected non-provider errors are now logged without their message, which hurts debugging.
fixes.do: When the caught error is not an AppError, append error.message to the sanitized log line; provider errors are already wrapped, so no CLI output can reach this path.

fix_results.what: Unexpected non-provider errors are logged without their message (server/src/app.js).
fix_results.note: Log line now reads '[id] INTERNAL_ERROR <message>' for non-AppError throws; browser body stays generic; provider and AppError logs unchanged. Verified by the new test and a manual loopback reproduction saved in evidence.
